name: Rubik's Cube Philippine Open 2015
information: Registration fee is 400php which is good for the first 6 events. An additional of 50php shall be added per extra event registered. Competitors coming from the Philippines shall abide by the payment-first system before WCA registrations canl be approved. For more info, kindly check Pinoy Cubers facebook page or message the admins of the Pinoy Cubers facebook group for details.
